failures.evidence:
Round 7's render (ad3351ac, render.go: the loop over misreadRawTitle) writes each title line feed raw, parses the whole rendered document back, and renders the whole document again with one more image escaped for each misread image. So a document of n images whose titles hold a blank line costs n full parses and renders. pmdoc at 999f2d4b (tester/head-r7, a throwaway scale test, now removed): 250 / 500 / 1000 / 2000 such images (7 / 14 / 28 / 56 KB) take ParseForWrite 2.1 s / 11 s / 36 s / 2 min 35 s and Render 2.2 s / 8.9 s / 41 s / 2 min 30 s; 2000 images with plain titles take 0.11 s and 0.04 s. Real server (tester/live/timed.sh, r7time.out): POST /api/v1/issues/LIVE-1/artifacts of 1000 '![x](i.png "a

b")' paragraphs (28 KB) -> HTTP 201 after 70.8 s, and the next plain 18 KB write waited 5.9 s behind it. Base 748e8d95 (r7basetime.out) answers the same POST HTTP 400 in 0.055 s. One write may hold 65,536 elements, about 32,000 such images, so at this rate a single upload costs hours of server CPU. Round 6 (733ebfdb) rendered the 2000 in 0.10 s. Red test TestRenderIsLinearInImagesWhoseTitlesHoldABlankLine in packages/envoy/internal/dispatch/pmdoc/linear_test.go, commit e39b6dd5f7abc0dd32f6dd5bd33ebbfac811d200, fails with `cd packages/envoy && go test ./internal/dispatch/pmdoc/ -run 'TestRenderIsLinearInImagesWhoseTitlesHoldABlankLine$'` ('took more than 30s'); the same test passes at 733ebfdb in 0.10 s.
